description:
List an inscription for sale on the P2P trade ledger.

Creates a new offer entry authenticated with a BIP-137 signature from the active
wallet's BTC address. The inscription must be in the wallet or otherwise owned
by the signing address for the trade to be verifiable by counterparties.

Requires an unlocked wallet with Bitcoin keys.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

asking_price_sats.description: Asking price in satoshis (omit for open price negotiation)

inscription_id.description: Inscription ID in txid+index format, e.g. abc123...i0

to_agent.description: Target buyer BTC address (omit for public listing)

name: ordinals_p2p_create_offer
